title: your BODY is hiding this from you 😳 | part 2
description: Your own body has secrets. Five of them, right now. Part 3 tomorrow.
hook: Your body is hiding things from you.
facts: You are about one centimeter taller in the morning than at night.
Your stomach acid is strong enough to dissolve metal.
Your body glows in the dark. The light is just too weak for your eyes.
Your brain burns about twenty percent of all your energy.
You will blink around twenty thousand times today.
outro: Follow for part three. Your body has more secrets.
